title: Code and data for "Quadratic APN functions of F_2^10 with a prime-order self-equivalence"

creators.name: Bellini, Emanuele
creators.affiliation: Technology Innovation Institute, Abu Dhabi, UAE

description: Scripts, C and Python sources, generated data and stored results of the paper by E. Bellini, "Quadratic APN functions of F_2^10 with a prime-order self-equivalence". The repository contains the enumeration of the 299 types of prime-order linear self-equivalences (A, B) at n = 10, the proof criteria that exclude most of them, the generic symmetric tree search sym10 and the dedicated solvers for the hard types (24, 47, 73), the outputs and EA-equivalence checks of the searches, the four new quadratic APN classes, and verify.py to re-check the claims.
